what.question: What exactly does Orbit do?
what.answer: It builds a persistent model of your career — your profile and goal — then uses three specialized AI agents to analyze your skill gaps, generate an ordered roadmap to close them, and give you feedback on your CV against your specific target role.

control.question: Is the AI making decisions for me?
control.answer: No. Every output is advisory. You control every action a recommendation suggests — nothing executes on your behalf, and you can override or ignore any recommendation at any time.

explain.question: Can I see why the AI recommended something?
explain.answer: Yes, on request, for every output. Explanations are grounded in your actual profile and goal data — never a generic justification.

data.question: What happens to my data?
data.answer: It's yours. You can view everything stored about you at any time, delete specific data independent of your account, or delete your account entirely — which removes everything.

pricing.question: Do I need to pay to get started?
pricing.answer: There's a free tier to start. You can view and manage your subscription, or cancel, at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.whatWeStoreBody: {{brand}} stores exactly what it needs to build your career model: your profile (background, education, experience, skills), your stated goal, the skill-gap analyses and roadmaps generated from them, and any CV or profile document you submit for feedback.
privacy.yourControlBody: You can view everything stored about you at any time from Settings. You can delete specific data — such as your profile fields or an individual CV feedback round — independent of your account. You can delete your account entirely, which removes your identity and every piece of data associated with it.
privacy.howUsedBody: Your data is used only to personalize your own experience — to generate your own analyses, roadmap, and feedback. It is never used to shape another user's experience by default.
privacy.aiProcessingBody: Skill-gap analyses, roadmaps, and CV feedback are generated by AI models processing your profile, goal, and submitted documents. Every AI-generated output is advisory — you retain final control over every action it recommends.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy or your data can be directed through your account settings.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.serviceBody: {{brand}} provides skill-gap analysis, roadmap generation, and CV/profile feedback for individual career planning. Outputs are advisory — {{brand}} does not guarantee any employment outcome.
terms.accountBody: You're responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide. One active goal is tracked at a time; previous goals are retained, not deleted, when you change it.
terms.billingBody: A free tier and a paid tier are available. You can cancel your subscription at any time directly from Settings, without contacting support. Cancellation retains your data and does not delete your account.
terms.acceptableUseBody: Submit only your own information and documents. Don't attempt to access another user's data or use the service to generate content unrelated to your own career development.
terms.changesBody: These terms may be updated as the product evolves. Continued use after a change constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
